mentions.name: Humanity Jobs
mentions.description: Humanity Jobs is a job board that helps users find jobs across humanitarian areas—helping people, addressing poverty, and traveling in the world and developing countries. The goal is to build a comprehensive list of jobs from internationally verified organizations.
